text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This paper presents a national-scale (Sweden) spatially explicit land-use model (CRAFTY-Sweden) focusing on forestry and agriculture, incorporating forest owner decision-making and climate change effects. The primary objective is future land-use change and ecosystem service provision simulation, with explicit modeling of ≥2 future scenarios combining socio-economic pathways (SSPs) and climate change (RCPs). The model outputs include mapped land-use projections across Sweden at 1 km² resolution, with quantitative analysis of land-use and ecosystem service changes. The study includes quantitative metrics of change and scenario comparisons. It is not a review paper. The focus is not on species/ecology only, nor purely economic or bioenergy without LULC change. The scale is national, not global or regional. Therefore, it meets all core inclusion criteria and none of the exclusion criteria.)
